content.comment_body: Hello, is there a way to modify the 'On threshold' value of an up/down counter using a 0-10V analog input?

Yes, this can be done if you're using [product_name] with [article_no]. Check the attached file. Additionally, you can assign Di7 as an analog input and Di8 as a digital input. With programming, it's even possible to use a single input such as Di7 for both analog and digital purposes through multiplexing. Refer to the attachment for details—the second part of the diagram shows an example of multiplexing.
A follow-up question: is it possible to use just one digital input on [product_name] with [version_no] as an analog input?
